$comment: The release-candidate tag the compat CREDENTIAL lanes run against (ADR-0056). null = no RC cut yet: the credential crons refuse rather than test main. Cutting an RC is a founder action: push the vX.Y.Z-rc.N tag, then bump rcTag here in a reviewed PR. scripts/compat-credential-ref.mjs resolves it.
$rcBumpMarkerComment: #1302 — while rcTag is non-null, .github/workflows/compat-credential-freeze-guard.yml refuses any PR touching a file the credential harness executes (derived, see docs/ci/credential-freeze-guard.md), unless this object is ALSO present and unexpired: rcBumpMarker: { date: 'YYYY-MM-DD', expires: 'YYYY-MM-DD', reason: '...', paths?: ['exact/frozen/path', ...] }. #1635: a marker exempts only the PR that introduces it (absent at that PR's merge base, or a new date/reason); a marker inherited from main exempts nothing, and a pin-only PR that just removes or shortens the marker passes without one. #1641: a PR changing rcTag fails unless that tag already exists on the remote and is reachable from main.

rcBumpMarker.reason: #1560 (rc.2 16.3.5 re-credential, PR C): bumps NEXTJS_REF in .github/workflows/test-e2e-deploy.yml from v16.2.12 to v16.3.5 and test/deploy-tests-manifest.knext.json's $knextQuarantines/rules.exclude to match, both frozen-harness files touched mid-window while rcTag (still v1.0.0-rc.1 in this PR) is live. Ledger change is real-evidence-backed, dispatching all four credential cells at v16.3.5 on a throwaway branch (runs 36638853381 node/turbopack, 36638856495 node/webpack, 36638859599 bun/turbopack, 36638862596 bun/webpack): of the 12 runtime-prefetch entries, 8 are removed because they cleared with zero test-content failures on every cell backed by the upstream root-cause fix; the remaining 4 (prefetch-layout-sharing, segment-cache-refresh, segment-cache-per-page-dynamic-stale-time, client-cache.parallel-routes) are removed instead because upstream itself wraps them in describe.skip at v16.3.5, so they did not execute rather than passing. The 2 bun-edge-fetch entries were re-stamped (reaudited: v16.3.5) from the same dispatch evidence, though the specific cases they quarantine sit in suites.flakey and were jest-deselected, so those cases were not exercised in these runs either. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: the two node runs cited above are NOT clean overall — each fails knext's own bytecode-liveness gate on shards 6 and 7 (`redirect-rewrite-dynamic-basepath.test.ts` shard 6, `redirect-rewrite-dynamic.test.ts` shard 7), both new-in-16.3.x upstream fixtures whose cold bake boot exceeds the driver's timeout (#1572, REOPENED 2026-09-30: the gate fails 8/8 node shard-6/7 jobs across all four cited node runs). That is a real, currently-open regression this PR does not fix, and separate from the ledger re-audit above (whose test-content assertions are unaffected, per each shard's own JSON) — the node cells' re-credential at v16.3.5 waits on #1572 landing, not on this PR. rcTag itself does NOT move here — that is PR B (#1660), gated on this PR's merge landing first. Expiry is the planned merge day; if the merge slips, re-set it to the actual merge day. Remove this marker once no longer needed.
